title: Taiwan MND: 3 PLA Aircraft, 5 PLAN Ships Detected; One Aircraft Crosses Median Line
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported 3 sorties of PLA aircraft, 5 PLAN vessels and 4 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) on September 28. One aircraft crossed the median line and entered Taiwan's northern ADIZ. The previous day's report showed 2 sorties, 5 PLAN vessels and 6 official ships.

media.caption: Taiwan detects 3 PLA aircraft, 5 PLAN ships operating around island
